edges.cite: GoF Design Patterns, Abstract Factory 'Related Patterns'/Implementation
edges.note: AbstractFactory classes are often implemented with factory methods, one per product.
A concrete factory can be implemented with Prototype: it clones a prototype per product.
An application typically needs only one concrete factory, so it is often a Singleton.

edges.cite: GoF Design Patterns, Factory Method 'Related Patterns'
edges.note: Factory methods are usually called within template methods to create the objects the algorithm needs.
Both defer object creation; Factory Method subclasses a creator, Prototype clones an exemplar.
An object adapter forwards client calls to the adaptee held by composition.
Wraps unrelated concrete classes in a parallel adapter hierarchy to make them polymorphic.
Similar structure, different intent: Bridge is designed up-front to vary impl, Adapter retrofits incompatible interfaces.
A Facade defines a new simpler interface; an Adapter converts to an existing expected interface.
Decorator changes an object's skin (wrapping), Strategy changes its guts (pluggable algorithm).
A decorator can be viewed as a degenerate composite with exactly one component and added responsibilities.
Both wrap an object; Decorator keeps the interface and adds behavior, Adapter changes the interface.
Same interface as the subject; Proxy controls access, Decorator adds responsibilities.
A decorator forwards each request to the wrapped component, augmenting before/after.
The surrogate forwards requests to the real subject after access control.
The context delegates state-dependent behavior to the current state object.

edges.cite: GoF Design Patterns, Template Method 'Related Patterns'
edges.note: GoF: Template Method uses inheritance to vary part of an algorithm; Strategy uses delegation to vary the whole algorithm.
The handle/abstraction delegates operations to its implementor object.
Bureaucracy is a compound pattern built on Composite to form the hierarchical part-whole structure.
Each level mediates the interaction among its child objects (Manager as Mediator).
Requests are escalated up the hierarchy along a chain of responsible objects.
Changes propagate to keep the hierarchy internally consistent via Observer notification.

edges.cite: GoF Design Patterns, Chain of Responsibility 'Related Patterns'
edges.note: Often applied with Composite: a component's parent acts as its successor in the chain.
A visitor commonly carries a collecting parameter to accumulate results while traversing a structure.
When accumulation logic grows, turn the collecting method into a Method Object holding the accumulator.
Both aggregate across steps; a pipeline returns fresh values, a collecting parameter mutates one shared accumulator.
Two decompositions of one entity: OO components hold behavior, ECS stores components as data processed by systems.
The entity delegates each domain concern to its corresponding component object.
The owning entity often mediates messages between its otherwise-decoupled components.
Compile-time Template Method: the base class calls derived members through the CRTP self-type.
Both are compile-time customization mechanisms and are frequently combined in C++ library design.
C++ mixins are typically realized by inheriting from a template parameter, i.e. via CRTP/parameterized base.
Both add a behavior slice; a mixin at compile time via inheritance, a decorator at runtime via wrapping.
Both factor behavior shared by many classes: one inherited supertype vs several composable behavior slices.
The mappers of a persistence layer commonly share a Layer Supertype holding their common behavior.
Active Record classes typically extend a Layer Supertype carrying shared row/table plumbing.
A stateless domain service fetches and stores the aggregates it operates on through repositories.
Domain services often raise domain events to signal significant outcomes of their operations.
Services apply Specification predicate objects to select or validate domain objects.
Both add operations to a class family without editing it; Visitor via double dispatch, Extension Object via queryable interfaces.
Roles are extensions attached and detached at runtime; the two patterns are closely related realizations.
POSA2 Extension Interface is essentially the same query-for-a-typed-interface idea under another name.
Both give polymorphism to types lacking a common base: External Polymorphism at runtime, CRTP at compile time.
Type Erasure is the modern C++ realization of the External Polymorphism idea, hiding the adapter behind value semantics.
An Abstract Factory can create subsystem objects behind a Facade so clients stay decoupled from concrete classes.
Both abstract interactions among objects; a Mediator's colleagues know it, a Facade's subsystem does not know the facade.
A facade is usually needed only once per subsystem, so it is often made a Singleton.
Wrapper Facade is a Facade specialized to encapsulate low-level (often C) functions and data behind an OO interface.
A backend module exposes a facade over a subsystem's internal modules, a domain-specific application of Facade.
Flyweight is combined with Composite to share leaf nodes across a logically hierarchical (DAG) structure.
State objects are frequently implemented as shared, context-free Flyweights.
Strategy objects that hold no per-context state are often implemented as Flyweights.
The per-class vtable is exactly a table of function pointers indexed by method slot.
Dynamic dispatch in C is realized by looking up the method in a per-class function-pointer table.
A stored function pointer selected from the table is a C-level realization of a pluggable Strategy.
Both replace switch dispatch with indirection: a reflectively-invoked selector name vs an indexed function pointer.
Multiple interceptors registered at one dispatch point are invoked as a chain of handlers.
The framework passes a context object to each interceptor giving controlled access to internal state.
Interceptors are notified of framework-internal events much as observers are notified of subject changes.
Registered interceptors are invoked by the framework through callback methods at dispatch points.
The abstract syntax tree of grammar-rule classes is an instance of Composite.
Flyweight shares terminal symbols that recur throughout the abstract syntax tree.
An Iterator can traverse the AST structure the interpreter evaluates.
A Visitor lets each interpretation operation be maintained in one class instead of spread across node classes.
A tree-walking interpreter is the direct realization of GoF Interpreter: recursively evaluate each AST node.
The interpret operation runs over an abstract syntax tree built from the grammar.
Iterators are often applied to recursive structures such as Composites.
Polymorphic iterators rely on factory methods to instantiate the appropriate Iterator subclass.
An iterator can use a Memento to capture and later restore the state of an iteration.
The Volcano open/next/close operator model is the database-query specialization of Iterator.
Data Mapper is a Mapper between the in-memory object model and the database, keeping them ignorant of each other.
Both decouple two parties; with a Mediator the parties know it, with a Mapper neither party is aware of it.
The degenerate base Visitor is an empty marker interface used with a runtime cast to the per-element interface.
Both attach a compile-time-checkable property to a type carrying no runtime state: an empty interface vs a type parameter.
Colleagues communicate state changes to the mediator (ChangeManager) using the Observer pattern.
Both sit between many objects to cut coupling; Event Aggregator funnels many sources' events, a Mediator coordinates known colleagues.
A command can store a Memento of state it must restore to support undo.
Undo/redo stacks store mementos of state to roll executed operations back and forward.
Observer (aka Publish-Subscribe) couples subject to dependents in-process; a Publish-Subscribe Channel decouples them via messaging.
Qt Signals and Slots is a concrete, type-checked realization of the Observer notification mechanism.
Rx observable streams generalize Observer to composable, time-varying sequences of notifications.
Data binding keeps source and target in sync by observing change notifications on the bound property.
Both vary behavior without subclassing; Strategy uses a delegate object, Pluggable Selector stores a method name.
A stored selector can switch behavior reflectively instead of introducing a State subclass per mode.
Both relocate a class's data into a separate hidden object; Pimpl for a compilation firewall, Private Class Data for write protection.
The main class reaches its state only by delegating access to the separate data object.
Both stop callers from mutating internal state: one by read-only encapsulation, the other by handing out copies.
Designs making heavy use of Composite benefit from Prototype to clone whole structures.
Designs making heavy use of Decorator benefit from Prototype to copy decorated objects.
A Hardware Proxy is a Proxy that encapsulates and guards access to a device's registers.
RPC uses a client-side proxy/stub with the remote object's interface to marshal calls across the wire.
A Registry is a well-known object, most commonly made globally reachable as a Singleton.

edges.cite: Fowler, 'Inversion of Control Containers and the Dependency Injection pattern'
edges.note: Looking services up in a Registry/Service Locator vs having them injected are competing ways to obtain collaborators.
A Service Locator is a Registry of services that clients query by key/type.
A Multiton is a Registry keyed by name whose managed objects are instances of the class itself.
A role decorates the core object, forwarding core requests and adding context-specific interface.
Both let an object present different behavior over time: Role Object by client context, State by internal state.
DI wires the concrete implementation to a client that depends only on the separated interface.
A Plugin links the implementation to the separated interface at configuration time.
A Gateway's interface is often defined as a Separated Interface so clients can be tested against a stub.
Both externalize behavior over a set of classes; a Servant takes objects as parameters, a Visitor uses double dispatch.
Both supply common behavior to otherwise-unrelated classes from outside the classes themselves.
Shared behavior provided by a helper that operates on passed objects vs mixed into each class by inheritance.
Composite Specification combines leaf specifications with and/or/not into a predicate tree.
A repository can select objects that satisfy a Specification passed to it as a query criterion.
Both encapsulate selection criteria as first-class objects; Specification tests candidates, Query Object builds a query.
Both externalize business rules for evaluation; Specifications compose predicates, a rules engine matches many rules.
Many of the consequences of Strategy also follow from Sponsor-Selector; sponsors supply candidate strategies to a selector.
Both dynamically pick a suitable candidate: Sponsor-Selector scores resources, Product Trader selects a product type to create.
Near-identical structure, different intent: State switches behavior as internal state changes, Strategy as the client chooses an algorithm.
The State pattern (objects-for-states) is one object-oriented realization of a finite state machine.

edges.cite: GoF Design Patterns, Template Method 'Related Patterns'
edges.note: Template Method varies part of an algorithm via inheritance; Strategy varies the whole algorithm via delegation.
A function object (functor/lambda) is a lightweight realization of a Strategy passed to an algorithm.
Both bring multiple-inheritance-like composition to single-inheritance languages: paired partner objects vs mixed-in slices.
The two partner objects hold references to each other and forward requests across the twin boundary.
Both split one concept into two collaborating objects; Twin to fake multiple inheritance, Bridge to vary implementation.
A type object can serve as a prototype from which its instances are created by cloning.
A type object can hold Strategy objects that define behavior shared by all instances of that type.
Both model a category of things; a type-safe enum is fixed at compile time, a Type Object is a runtime-extensible instance.
The view handler coordinates dependencies among views, mediating their interaction.
The view handler organizes view updates by propagating change notifications to open views.
View Handler works with Command Processor: view operations (open/tile/close) are handled as commands.
The server acts as a factory that creates a fresh session object per connecting client.

edges.cite: Pryce, 'Abstract Session' (PLoPD4); cf. J2EE Session Facade
edges.note: The session object gives each client a typed facade over the per-conversation server services.
Handing each client an opaque session handle keeps per-client state off a shared global Registry lookup.
Both build complex objects; Builder constructs step by step and returns the product last, Abstract Factory returns a family immediately.
Composite is what the builder often builds: the director drives a builder to assemble a part-whole tree.
A MacroCommand is a Composite of commands, running a list of sub-commands as one.
A command copied before being placed on a history list acts as a Prototype (cloned to record it).
Visitors apply an operation over an object structure defined by Composite, visiting each node.
An Abstract Factory can create and configure a particular Bridge, decoupling clients from the implementor chosen.
